description: § 59(j) does not cap a kiddie-tax child's AMT exemption: § 55(d)(4)(A)(iii) says it "shall not apply" for taxable years beginning after 2017, and the 2025 Exemption Worksheet has no such step. A dependent child: wages $5,000 (standard deduction $5,450, taxable income $0), ISO spread $120,000. Line 1b −$450 + line 2a $5,450 + $120,000 → AMTI $125,000; exemption the full $88,100; line 6 $36,900 × 26% = $9,594; regular tax $0 → AMT $9,594. (Capping the exemption at $5,000 + $9,550 gave $28,717.)
